On this small sorghum plot, I will manage it with what my household can afford and what is available here. Rain is what I depend on, so I will not irrigate, and because fertilizer and improved seed are often hard to get on time, I will mostly rely on local seed and manure from home. I may use a little chemical fertilizer if I can get it, but not much, and I do not expect to use pesticide on this plot.
